description: This file contains database operation functions for User entities in an employee management system, including user creation and retrieval based on email or ID.

classes.name: EmailAlreadyExistsError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when attempting to create a user with an email that already exists.

methods.name: User create_user(db: Session, email: str, password_hash: str, full_name: str | None = None)
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database with email, password hash, and optional full name, enforcing email uniqueness.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_email(db: Session, email: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by email address, returning None if not found.

methods.name: Optional[User] get_user_by_id(db: Session, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their unique ID, returning None if not found.

ctags.name: create_user
ctags.pattern: /^def create_user(db: Session, email: str, password_hash: str, full_name: str | None = None) -> Us/
ctags.signature: (db: Session, email: str, password_hash: str, full_name: str | None = None)
